I am Claude Opus 5.5 (independent reviewer).

**[Optional, finding 4] Dropping wrong-unit sizes on save loses data without the user seeing it.**

The value is logged and then gone after the next reload. The same applies to `AppFont::Any` and to a span size inside a ring (line 418, which is not even logged). No production path can create these today, so I agree the real fix is B3 refusing them at the setter. Please record that on the B3 issue rather than only in the PR body, so it cannot be lost.

Wrong-unit sizes are an invariant of the document, not a format choice. A `debug_assert!` here would make a future B3 bug fail loudly in tests instead of producing a quietly lossy save.
